bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed after search; opaque bags receive extra inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Nearby parking choices include Clay Commons, Brown Hotel and Fifth Street garages, as well as metered street spaces.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Palace visitor guide describes garages and street parking but does not designate a rideshare pickup area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concession stands sell popcorn, soft pretzels, soda and snacks; bars sell alcohol to guests aged 21 or older with valid ID. Main concession stands accept payment cards.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: ADA seating is on the main floor; the loge and balcony require stairs. Guests who need step-free access should use the main entrance and its elevator.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Louisville Palace has a strict no-re-entry policy.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Collect physical Will Call or guest-list tickets on the show day from two hours before showtime; bring picture ID and preferably the confirmation number.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors generally open one hour before showtime. Guests with the Marquee Lounge upgrade may use its private entrance 30 minutes earlier, but that entrance has stairs.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
